scope_note: This is a SYNTHETIC benchmark project (L1). It is not a record of any real company's project and does not reproduce the history of any real-world case in data/l3_ground_truth/. project.project_name: BatteryCo Hungary EV Battery Manufacturing Complex (Synthetic Hero Project)
project.region: Northeast Hungary (synthetic site; not modeled on any specific existing town or real project)
project.description: SYNTHETIC benchmark project. A fictional Korean battery manufacturer ('BatteryCo') builds a greenfield EV battery cell and module/pack manufacturing complex in Hungary, from feasibility study through construction, equipment installation, commissioning, and start of production. This project and all of its tasks, dates, costs, and companies are synthetic and were generated to serve as a realistic benchmark input for the REPLAN agent; it is not a record of any real company's project and does not reproduce the history of any real-world case in data/l3_ground_truth/.

wbs.task_description: Techno-economic feasibility study for an overseas battery cell and module manufacturing complex.
Evaluate and select the Hungarian industrial site for the plant.
Close project financing package and construction-phase insurance.
Select the EPC general contractor and local civil contractor.
Acquire the selected industrial land parcel.
Baseline ecological and hydrological survey of the site.
Formal environmental impact assessment submitted to the regulator.
Regulatory approval of the environmental permit.
Soil and foundation-bearing capacity survey of the site.
Negotiate grid connection capacity and water supply agreement.
Detailed civil, structural, and MEP engineering design package.
Submit and obtain the building/construction permit from the regulator.
Final zoning and building-code sign-off from local authorities.
Finalize process equipment specifications and select equipment vendors.
Place order for long-lead cell production equipment (coating, winding, assembly).
Place order for long-lead module and pack assembly/automation equipment.

risk_profile.monitoring_target: Environmental/construction permit status; permitting-regime or exemption changes; inspection holds
risk_profile.rationale: L3 evidence (e.g. case V3-006, a Hungarian battery-plant permitting case) shows permitting-regime changes and safety-driven suspensions can delay trial/mass production by several months.

risk_profile.monitoring_target: Specialized labor availability; work-authorization/visa status of vendor technicians on-site
risk_profile.geography: Hungary (site) and equipment-vendor home countries (South Korea, Germany)
risk_profile.rationale: L3 evidence (e.g. cases V2-001 and V3-001, both labor-shortage/enforcement cases) shows labor disruptions can delay equipment installation and commissioning by 2-3 months or more.

risk_profile.monitoring_target: Severe weather events; grid emergency load-shed orders
risk_profile.rationale: L3 evidence (case V2-003, a severe winter storm) shows a single weather event can force a fab offline for 6+ weeks; civil construction phases are generally weather-sensitive.

risk_profile.monitoring_target: International shipping schedule adherence; customs clearance duration
risk_profile.geography: Vendor home countries to Hungary (in transit)
risk_profile.rationale: Equipment is shipped internationally from South Korea and Germany, exposing the schedule to shipping and customs delay risk (WBS tasks in the 6.5-6.9 range).

risk_profile.monitoring_target: Vendor equipment manufacturing/FAT schedule adherence; installation and calibration progress; process yield during ramp-up
risk_profile.rationale: L3 evidence (case V3-007, a repeatedly-restated fab timeline) shows equipment/process and funding-driven delays can compound into multi-year slips.

risk_profile.monitoring_target: Grid connection agreement and substation energization schedule
risk_profile.rationale: Utility connection is a common construction dependency chain gating equipment hookup and commissioning; monitor grid capacity agreements and energization dates.

risk_profile.monitoring_target: Construction material and component supply availability
risk_profile.rationale: L3 evidence (cases V3-002/V3-003/V3-004, semiconductor-shortage cases) shows supply-chain shocks can idle production lines for days-to-weeks with a clear, well-documented numeric pattern.

risk_profile.monitoring_target: EPC/civil contractor schedule performance; capital-allocation and financing decisions
risk_profile.rationale: L3 evidence (case V2-004) shows contractor/financial decisions can pause construction for 18+ months with an ambiguous, multi-milestone restart.

risk_profile.monitoring_target: Export controls, tariffs, and tax-policy changes affecting equipment-vendor countries
risk_profile.rationale: L2 corpus records (e.g. RS-016 EV tax-credit policy change, RS-019 rare-earth export controls) show geopolitical/trade policy shifts can affect battery-sector project economics and supply chains.
